items.description: Babymonster exceeded 100 million plays on Spotify with “Choom,” the title track from its third EP, label YG Entertainment announced Wednesday. The single reached the milestone in about six months as the girl group’s eighth song to do so. The performance video for the hip-hop dance tune hit 100 million views on YouTube as of Monday, while the music video passed 200 million in October. Six of the group's seven members are in the middle of a world tour named after the EP, which began in late June.
